n: 4.5 Cu. Ft. Ultra Large Capacity Front Load Washer - White
desc: The LG 4.5 cu. ft. Ultra Large Capacity Smart wi-fi Enabled Front Load Washer is the the perfect way to tackle any laundry challenge. Its compact design and 4.5 cu. ft. capacity make it ideal for those who want to save space while still enjoying all the benefits of a large-capacity washer.
hl: See how LG Front Load Washers were rated on reliability, performance, and energy & water efficiency.⁴
Power Clean Big Loads in Under 30 Minutes¹

Deep Clean with the Power of Steam
AAFA certified LG washers with the Allergiene™ Cycle remove over 95%² of pet dander and dust.
ColdWash™ technology penetrates deep into fabrics, for cold water savings with warm water performance.
LG closet-depth washers have a shallower depth to fit in more places & add sleek style to any room.
Unlike porcelain & plastic, LG's stainless steel tub avoids chips that snag on & ruin clothing.
